title: PICK CHOOSE LOVE ME
tagline: A modern blind-date app BY plan  and match who meet ur soul
description:
Web3 dating platform powered by:
Pyth Entropy (verifiable random matching)
AI-driven recommendations via ASI
PYUSD stablecoin payments for premium features
No bank accounts required
It centers on Date Plans instead of photos, mixing blockchain transparency, AI intelligence, and crypto payments.




This project helps singles match through date plans, not profile pics — because love deserves more than a swipe. 

🔗 : https://pick-me-choose-me-love-me.vercel.app
how_its_made:
Tech stack:
Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Material-UI
Smart contracts: Solidity + Hardhat
Integrations: Wagmi + RainbowKit
Oracle: Pyth Entropy
Payments: PYUSD
Innovations:
Dual randomness (Pyth when wallet connected; fallback otherwise)
Learning AI with explainable recommendations
ERC20 approval flow
Local + on-chain state sync
